data.narrative:
Reflection AI is a Series A artificial intelligence and software company founded by Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe comprising one public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private-stage comparable firms in the AI & Software sector, including Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, Figure AI, and Scale AI.

The Stage-Progression method was not applicable due to data integrity concerns: the reported last post-money valuation of $25.0B implies a 50x step-up multiple, which would yield $50.0B—more than 20x the company's total capital raised of $2.0B. This ratio flags the base figure as unreliable. The Peer-Median method was therefore primary. Analysis of three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers yielded a median valuation of $3.2B (range: $2.0B to $5.6B), anchored on Black Forest Labs at Series B valuation of $3.2B, Physical Intelligence at $5.6B, and Field AI at $2.0B.

This triangulation supports a valuation range of $2.8B to $3.7B, with a median of $3.2B. The compressed range reflects reliance on a single method. Key uncertainties include the stability and comparability of the peer cohort—particularly the stage differences between Series A target and Series B peers—and the absence of revenue or growth metrics to weight peer comparables. Validation against public market multiples (via Palantir) and additional Series A stage data would strengthen conviction.
